_doc: ADR 0026 v2 / M27 — validates the 'third-party Sinatra plugins unblocked' claim with a fixture-local plugin that exercises the M27 AST family. The plugin reopens Sinatra::Base and uses define_method with block-capture (the M27 A4 batch) to install a family of helper methods; the app then calls each helper through its routes. Same code runs on rubyrs (via the vendored micro-Sinatra shared with sinatra_hello) and CRuby (via the real Sinatra gem). Validates: (a) class reopen on a gem-provided class, (b) define_method inside an iter-block with closure capture, (c) helper methods visible to dispatch-instance route blocks, (d) module + frozen constant access from inside the captured block.
name: sinatra_plugin_smoke

normalize._doc: Sinatra+WEBrick appends ;charset=utf-8 to default Content-Type; rubyrs's _http_server battery emits the bare media type. Both valid per RFC 7231 §3.1.1.5; collapse to bare form.
